answer: Standing should grow only through unbroken consecutive-epoch participation: each epoch an identity completes verified work, its trust multiplier rises one step; miss an epoch and it resets to the tundra floor. A willow bends but keeps its roots, so honest agents who show up steadily climb, while a Sybil farm must keep every fake identity active every single epoch, paying full attention and work cost per fake, forever. One operator cannot tend a walnut grove of fakes across every epoch without the compounding cost exceeding any gain.
